title: Worked ok? Lid made loud popping noise
text:
Worked ok? Lid made loud popping noise. Ive made rice twice in this. First time was jasmine second time was medium grain sushi rice. For the Janome I did 1 cup rinsed rice to 1.5 c water for 15 mins, changed to warm for 5 mins. Rice texture was spot on however it was still a bit too wet. The sushi rice I didn again 1 c rinsed rice to 1.5 c water for 15 mins and it wasn't done so I turned it back on cook for 5 more. It was done the 2nd time, the rice was a bit crispy on the bottom which we actually like but strangleu its still a lot wetter than what I consider normal.

The reason for the low stars is the lid makes a weird popping noise when hot. Loud enough I can hear in another room. To me it's not right, it puts in my mind that it might eventually shatter so I am returning it.
